column1: # The catalogs, one row each. Both runtimes read this file; a new catalog is one new row.
# name      the catalog's name: --catalog <name>, catalogs.<name> in rules.json, and the owner
#           folder catalogs/<name> in the project and in the user folder
# shipped   the shipped entries, relative to the plugin root
# template  the shipped template, relative to the plugin root; a starting point for a new entry;
# order     alpha, or match (gates: stack, then plugin, then fallback)
# rule      the one check the template cannot express: shift (an ending and an item block),
#           fence:<lang> (a fence of that language with files, min and type), match (one Match
# legacy    the owner folder, user folder, paths key and template key an earlier version read,
#           still honoured; - when there were none
